column1: # The HDFS trees the cases run (each case.sh's repo=, under GC_TREES): the
# directory name and the branch of the Hadoop fork (HADOOP_FORK,
# prepare-trees.sh) it is checked out at.  All three stand on Apache Hadoop
# trunk 734dd8a67cd (2026-05-13); the hadoop-hdfs-bug-<jira> trees are graphchecker/hdfs-checks with one old bug put back.
